All fixed. Here's a summary of the **5 bugs** I found and corrected:

| # | Issue | Root Cause | Fix |
|---|-------|-----------|-----|
| 1 | Child properties silently overwritten | `<Import>` of parent came *after* child set properties — parent's unconditional assignments won | Moved `<Import>` to **top** of child file |
| 2 | `DefineConstants` lost across layers | Parent used `<DefineConstants>REPO_BUILD</DefineConstants>` (unconditional, no append) | Changed to `$(DefineConstants);REPO_BUILD` |
| 3 | Parent `NoWarn` (NU1702) lost | Child set `<NoWarn>CS1591;IDE0005</NoWarn>` without preserving parent value | Changed to `$(NoWarn);CS1591;IDE0005` |
| 4 | AOT cryptic errors on some machines | Unquoted condition `$(EnableAot) == true` — undefined property causes unpredictable evaluation | Quoted: `'$(EnableAot)' == 'true'` |
| 5 | Output path segments concatenated | `artifacts\bin` uses `\` which isn't a separator on Linux | Changed to `artifacts/bin` |
